title: 19 July 2013: Paul McCartney live at Safeco Field, Seattle
content:
Paul McCartney performed at Safeco Field in Seattle, Washington, USA, on 19 July 2013.

It was the 22nd show of the Out There Tour, which lasted for 91 dates between May 2013 and October 2015. This concert was seen by 45,229 fans.

I'm getting all psyched up for tonight's show in #Seattle … Who's coming? #OutThere

— Brian Ray (@brianrayguitar) July 19, 2013

Time to suit up for showtime here in #seattle and get #outthere with all you music freaks! B

— Brian Ray (@brianrayguitar) July 20, 2013

Towards the end of the show, former Nirvana members Dave Grohl, Krist Novoselic and Pat Smear joined McCartney’s band on stage. They performed ‘Cut Me Some Slack’, ‘Long Tall Sally’, ‘Get Back’, ‘Helter Skelter’, ‘Golden Slumbers’, ‘Carry That Weight’, and ‘The End’.

https://twitter.com/KristNovoselic/status/358483674133561344

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

Wow Seattle!!!!
'twas fun playing guitar with Dave, Pat & Krist!!! Surreal!!!#longtallsally
: ) >

— abe laboriel jr (@ogabejr) July 20, 2013

The Nirvana boys Dave, Kris and Pat joined us for a few numbers tonight in Seattle. Really nice guys and they play hard….

— Paul Wickens (@WixWickens) July 20, 2013

There have been many "firsts" in 24 years with Paul, but Long Tall Sally tonight in Seattle was a big one. #bucketlist

— Paul Wickens (@WixWickens) July 20, 2013

I missed the t off Krist Novoselic' name in my tweets, so apologies to him (a fellow accordionist) and here's some to make up for it. t t t

— Paul Wickens (@WixWickens) July 20, 2013

Just had what can only be described as an Epic night in Seattle w Macca and surviving Nirvana boys #Sirvana thank you, WA!

— Brian Ray (@brianrayguitar) July 20, 2013

#Seattle That was truly one for the books! #Sirvana rules~ Thanks to everyone #OutThere who came to rock out with us~ B

— Brian Ray (@brianrayguitar) July 20, 2013
